title.en: Asking the way on the fell
title.de: Nach dem Weg fragen am Fell

setting.sl: Na pobočju nad vasjo (fell: tako v Lake Districtu rečejo goram). Megla se spušča in ne najdeš več poti do jezerca (tarn). Ob kamnitem zidu brez malte (suhi zid) pase ovce pastir Jack.
setting.de: Am Hang über dem Dorf, auf dem Fell (so heißen die Berge im Lake District). Der Nebel kommt herunter, und du findest den Weg zum Bergsee (dem Tarn) nicht mehr. An der Trockenmauer hütet Schäfer Jack seine Schafe.
setting.it: Sul pendio sopra il paese, sul fell (così si chiamano i monti nel Lake District). Scende la nebbia e non trovi più il sentiero per il laghetto (il tarn). Vicino al muretto a secco il pastore Jack bada alle sue pecore.
setting.en: On the fellside above the village (in the Lake District the hills are fells). The mist is coming down and you can't find the path to the tarn, the little mountain lake. By the drystone wall, Shepherd Jack is with his sheep.

role: Shepherd Jack, out on the fell with his Herdwick sheep and his dog. Calm, kind, a man of few words; gives the way in short steps: follow the wall, over the stile, cross the beck, left at the cairn; the tarn is twenty minutes. Cumbrian words (fell, beck, tarn) and "Now then!".

goals.de: Sag, dass du dich verlaufen hast

goals.en: Ask the way to the tarn
goals.de: Frag nach dem Weg zum Tarn
goals.it: Chiedi la strada per il tarn

opener_sl: Now then! You look a bit lost. Where are you heading?

opener_en.sl: Zdravo! Videti ste malo izgubljeni. Kam pa greste?
opener_en.de: Na, grüß dich! Du siehst ein bisschen verloren aus. Wo willst du hin?
opener_en.it: Salve! Sembra un po' {m:perso|f:persa}. Dove sta andando?
opener_en.en: Hello there! You look a bit lost. Where are you going?

en.de: Hallo! Ich habe mich ein bisschen verlaufen.
en.en: Hello! I've lost my way a bit.

en.it: Da che parte è il tarn?
en.en: Where is the way to the tarn?

en.sl: čez prehod v zidu (stopnice čez ograjo)
en.de: über den Zauntritt (die Stufen über die Mauer)
en.it: oltre la scaletta (i gradini sopra il muro)
en.en: over the steps in the wall

en.it: All'ometto di pietre gira a sinistra.
en.en: Turn left at the pile of stones.
